text:
```yaml
name: CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Elixir
        uses: erlef/setup-elixir@v1
        with:
          elixir-version: '1.12'
          otp-version: '24'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: mix deps.get --only dev test

      - name: Run lint and tests
        run: mix format --check-formatted && mix test

      - name: Run quality check
        run: mix quality

  release:
    needs: ci
    on:
      workflow_dispatch:
        inputs:
          version:
            description: 'Version number'
            required: true
            type: string
    jobs:
      release:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
          - name: Checkout code
            uses: actions/checkout@v2

          - name: Set up Elixir
            uses: erlef/setup-elixir@v1
            with:
              elixir-version: '1.12'
              otp-version: '24'

          - name: Install dependencies
            run: mix deps.get --only prod

          - name: Create release
            uses: googleapis/release-please-action@v4
            with:
              token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
              release-type: 'auto'
              path: '.'
              target-branch: 'main'
              config-file: '.release-please-config.json'
              manifest-file: 'manifest.yaml'
              repo-url: 'https://github.com/agentjido/req_llm.git'
              github-api-url: 'https://api.github.com'
              github-graphql-url: 'https://api.github.com/graphql'
              fork: false
              include-component-in-tag: true
              proxy-server: ''
              skip-github-release: false
              skip-github-pull-request: false
              skip-labeling: false
```
